MS.S: PowerShell cmdlets for the Google Cloud Platform.

This module contains a set of cmdlets that let you manage Google Cloud Platform resources._x000D__x000A_Currently, the supported resources are Google Cloud Storage, Google Compute Engine,_x000D__x000A_Google Cloud DNS and Google Cloud SQL._x000D__x000A__x000D__x000A_The module also contains a PowerShell provider for Google Cloud Storage. This provider allows_x000D__x000A_you to use commands like 'cd', 'dir', 'copy' and 'del' to navigate and manipulate your data_x000D__x000A_in Cloud Storage as if the data were on a local file system._x000D__x000A__x000D__x000A_The module requires Google Cloud SDK to work.
